::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Incise Infotech Limited (incorporated 2010, registered in Delhi; offices in Noida and Bengaluru). Mainly a design-services and IP firm; its own product is the INC2106 linear LED driver IC, the smallest PDLI project by outlay (₹4.28 crore).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Semiconductor design services and verification IP, plus its INC2106 linear LED driver IC.
